question.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

exchange.sent: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
The supported impact is that AI data center technology changes push measurement needs away from only wireless signaling/non-signaling RF checks and toward high-speed digital, SI/PI, PCB material/stackup, interconnect, jitter/phase-noise, optical, and power-integrity measurements; the passages do not directly state that a CMX500-type signaling tester alone covers AI data center interconnect validation, because CMX500 is described for LTE/NR/WLAN device signaling, TX measurements, application tests, and non-signaling verification use cases rather than AI data center electrical/optical interconnect tests [19][24][95].
### What changes in AI data centers drive new measurement needs
AI/data center connectivity is described as a full-spectrum portfolio covering high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection, so measurement coverage must span more than RF signaling behavior [3].  
High-speed electrical connectivity includes signals from ASIC packages to system endpoints, OSFP connectors optimized for signal integrity and thermal management, 448G connector solutions, OSFP cable assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T aggregate bandwidth, next-generation backplane connectors, and 224 Gb/s PAM4 mezzanine connectors [61].  
Optical connectivity adds 224 Gb/s-per-lane XPO-LPO, 1.6T OSFP transceivers, CPO from electrical interposer to optical conversion module and fiber plant, and other optical transceiver / AOC / fiber deployment elements [62].  
Power and cooling connectivity adds high-current busbar / cable / circuit-board power distribution, +54V M-CRPS connectors, high-power cable assemblies, OSFP cold plate and cage assemblies, liquid cooling leak detection, and liquid cooling quick disconnects [63].  
AI server PCB sources say the trend pushes PCBs toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission, with material upgrades such as HVLP copper foil, M8 CCL, low dielectric, low loss, and high thermal-dissipation design, plus process challenges such as 30–40 layer mainboards and 12–14× aspect ratio [80].  
### Measurement capability implications
For PCB / material / stackup validation, the required capabilities include impedance by TDR, Dk/Df extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, sampling tests, and process monitoring context [7][9].  
For high-speed PCB / PCBA signal integrity, the cited flow includes IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and TL calculator, while the broader validation challenge includes Tx/Rx packages, PCBs, connectors, equalization, ADC/DSP, and DAC paths [56].  
For instrument roles, the cited high-speed validation blocks map interface tests to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices; reference-clock and PLL jitter performance to phase-noise analyzers and signal generators; PDN to scopes and network analyzers; and ADC/DAC frontend performance to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [56][57].  
For AI server ecosystem solution mapping, R&S ZNA/ZNB are mapped to PCB IL/TDR, connector/cable high-speed cable tests, PCBA high-speed trace tests, and GPU TDR, while R&S FSWP is mapped to LDO noise spectral density, clock jitter, and switch jitter / phase-noise tests [66][67][69].  
For power-integrity and power electronics contexts in the mapping, MXO is listed for power rail, multiphase DC, and PI, ZISO is listed in server mainboard and power-supply categories, and BMS test is listed in the power-supply category, but the source does not provide formal setup, options, fixtures, or frequency details [67][70].  
For optical / SiPh / CPO context, the mapping links optical VNA to R&S ZNA/ZNB plus partner components, and notes that CPO raises active/passive SiPh, advanced packaging, and test demand, but this is not a formal R&S application note or proof of production adoption [6].  
### What this means for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester
A CMX500-type signaling tester is confirmed for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput, PER, application tests, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and remote-control interfaces [19].  
The callbox material positions CMX500 around RF testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, Go-NoGo testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing, and R&D Testing, and example use cases include desense testing, pre-conformance, SRS RF measurements, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [22][23][95].  
The cited AI data center measurement needs are instead high-speed channel, PCB, interconnect, jitter/phase-noise, PDN, optical VNA, and power-integrity measurements, so the required non-signaling capability for AI data center technology is better evidenced as high-speed digital / SI / PI / optical / power measurement capability rather than cellular/WLAN signaling callbox capability [56][57][67][69].  
【推論】If “Signaling / Non-signaling Tester” means a wireless callbox such as CMX500, AI data center changes do not mainly add more cellular signaling requirements in the cited passages; they mainly add non-signaling high-speed digital, PCB, optical, jitter, and power-integrity measurement requirements, because the AI data center passages describe high-speed interconnect/PCB/optical/power changes while the CMX500 passages describe LTE/NR/WLAN signaling and non-signaling RF/device verification [19][24][61][62][63][67].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 規格與數字的使用限制
- [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 是正式 Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025）；引用數字時仍需保留原文條件，例如溫度、warm-up、level alignment、overrange、EVM waveform、SCS、modulation、channel bandwidth、port、RMS / PEP、typ. / meas. / nom.。
- [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 是 Features and Functions overview；其中沒有 tolerance limits 的 data 不具 binding。
- 不能從 [[R&S CMX-B500x]]、[[R&S CMX-B600x]]、`.xx` 後綴或其他命名規則推導完整料號；完整 order number 只能抄自來源或正式 configure / ordering data。
- [[R&S CMX-RF42E]] 的更多資料在另一份 PD 3609.7719.22 specifications；本頁不得補推該文件版次、日期或額外規格。
- 報價與組態相容性需交由正式 configure 工具確認；wiki 只忠實記錄來源文字。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz › 重點摘要
- [[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 full WLAN signaling test functionality，包括 [[Wi-Fi 7]]，整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓 wireless and mobile device manufacturers 可在 single antenna measurement system 中執行 comprehensive 4G、5G 與 [[WLAN]] [[OTA testing]]。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合的是 [[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 full Wi‑Fi（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）access point and station testing functionality。
- 來源明確新增：software now supports [[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（[[EN-DC]]）testing with the [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 來源稱這些擴充使 [[MVG]] multiprobe measurement systems 可在 single tester 內 fully support Wi‑Fi and cellular standards，包括 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 以 [[MVG]] Deputy Chief Executive Officer 身分表示，整合 WLAN testing 與進一步擴充 cellular testing capabilities 是 significant milestone，讓客戶可用 one [[R&S CMX500]] signaling tester 在 [[MVG]] OTA test systems 中測試 all essential current transmission standards。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in an [[MVG]] multiprobe OTA measurement system 的 manufacturers 可最大化 [[R&S CMX500]] extensive test functions，支援所有 WLAN standards including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，並支援 4G 與 5G mobile signals。
- 來源連回前一份合作背景新聞稿 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]]。
- [[MVG]] 公司背景段落與前一份來源一致：提供 electromagnetic waves visualization、antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements 方案；營運於 10 個國家；90% sales from exports；Group revenues exceeding €100 million。

- 本來源是 OneNote 複製出的 [[UAV]] signaling test solution 筆記，raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-17；正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、文件版次或適用客戶 / 專案。
- 來源指出無人機常使用多種通信技術，例子包含 proprietary radio / image transmission、Wi‑Fi、[[LTE]]、未來 [[5G]]、[[RTK]]、[[SATCOM]] 與 encrypted frequency-hopping radio。
- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 **400 MHz 至 8 GHz**，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的單一技術 signaling test。
- 來源列出 signaling test 可包含基本 RF 量測、application layer tests 與 protocol test；基本 RF 量測項目包含 Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。
- 來源指出如果 UAV 使用兩種以上通訊技術，通訊技術之間可能造成相互干擾；基於 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。
- 來源對多技術整合驗證的配置原則是：software options 合併上述 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 表格，hardware 以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。
- 來源末尾列出兩個待讀材料：本機 PDF `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf`，以及 SharePoint 上 `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`；正文未擷取。

### Short answer
The supported impact is that AI data center technology changes push measurement needs away from only wireless signaling/non-signaling RF checks and toward high-speed digital, SI/PI, PCB material/stackup, interconnect, jitter/phase-noise, optical, and power-integrity measurements; the passages do not directly state that a CMX500-type signaling tester alone covers AI data center interconnect validation, because CMX500 is described for LTE/NR/WLAN device signaling, TX measurements, application tests, and non-signaling verification use cases rather than AI data center electrical/optical interconnect tests [19][24][95].
### What changes in AI data centers drive new measurement needs
AI/data center connectivity is described as a full-spectrum portfolio covering high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection, so measurement coverage must span more than RF signaling behavior [3].  
High-speed electrical connectivity includes signals from ASIC packages to system endpoints, OSFP connectors optimized for signal integrity and thermal management, 448G connector solutions, OSFP cable assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T aggregate bandwidth, next-generation backplane connectors, and 224 Gb/s PAM4 mezzanine connectors [61].  
Optical connectivity adds 224 Gb/s-per-lane XPO-LPO, 1.6T OSFP transceivers, CPO from electrical interposer to optical conversion module and fiber plant, and other optical transceiver / AOC / fiber deployment elements [62].  
Power and cooling connectivity adds high-current busbar / cable / circuit-board power distribution, +54V M-CRPS connectors, high-power cable assemblies, OSFP cold plate and cage assemblies, liquid cooling leak detection, and liquid cooling quick disconnects [63].  
AI server PCB sources say the trend pushes PCBs toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission, with material upgrades such as HVLP copper foil, M8 CCL, low dielectric, low loss, and high thermal-dissipation design, plus process challenges such as 30–40 layer mainboards and 12–14× aspect ratio [80].  
### Measurement capability implications
For PCB / material / stackup validation, the required capabilities include impedance by TDR, Dk/Df extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, sampling tests, and process monitoring context [7][9].  
For high-speed PCB / PCBA signal integrity, the cited flow includes IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and TL calculator, while the broader validation challenge includes Tx/Rx packages, PCBs, connectors, equalization, ADC/DSP, and DAC paths [56].  
For instrument roles, the cited high-speed validation blocks map interface tests to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices; reference-clock and PLL jitter performance to phase-noise analyzers and signal generators; PDN to scopes and network analyzers; and ADC/DAC frontend performance to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [56][57].  
For AI server ecosystem solution mapping, R&S ZNA/ZNB are mapped to PCB IL/TDR, connector/cable high-speed cable tests, PCBA high-speed trace tests, and GPU TDR, while R&S FSWP is mapped to LDO noise spectral density, clock jitter, and switch jitter / phase-noise tests [66][67][69].  
For power-integrity and power electronics contexts in the mapping, MXO is listed for power rail, multiphase DC, and PI, ZISO is listed in server mainboard and power-supply categories, and BMS test is listed in the power-supply category, but the source does not provide formal setup, options, fixtures, or frequency details [67][70].  
For optical / SiPh / CPO context, the mapping links optical VNA to R&S ZNA/ZNB plus partner components, and notes that CPO raises active/passive SiPh, advanced packaging, and test demand, but this is not a formal R&S application note or proof of production adoption [6].  
### What this means for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester
A CMX500-type signaling tester is confirmed for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput, PER, application tests, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and remote-control interfaces [19].  
The callbox material positions CMX500 around RF testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, Go-NoGo testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing, and R&D Testing, and example use cases include desense testing, pre-conformance, SRS RF measurements, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [22][23][95].  
The cited AI data center measurement needs are instead high-speed channel, PCB, interconnect, jitter/phase-noise, PDN, optical VNA, and power-integrity measurements, so the required non-signaling capability for AI data center technology is better evidenced as high-speed digital / SI / PI / optical / power measurement capability rather than cellular/WLAN signaling callbox capability [56][57][67][69].  
【推論】If “Signaling / Non-signaling Tester” means a wireless callbox such as CMX500, AI data center changes do not mainly add more cellular signaling requirements in the cited passages; they mainly add non-signaling high-speed digital, PCB, optical, jitter, and power-integrity measurement requirements, because the AI data center passages describe high-speed interconnect/PCB/optical/power changes while the CMX500 passages describe LTE/NR/WLAN signaling and non-signaling RF/device verification [19][24][61][62][63][67].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 規格與數字的使用限制
- [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 是正式 Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025）；引用數字時仍需保留原文條件，例如溫度、warm-up、level alignment、overrange、EVM waveform、SCS、modulation、channel bandwidth、port、RMS / PEP、typ. / meas. / nom.。
- [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 是 Features and Functions overview；其中沒有 tolerance limits 的 data 不具 binding。
- 不能從 [[R&S CMX-B500x]]、[[R&S CMX-B600x]]、`.xx` 後綴或其他命名規則推導完整料號；完整 order number 只能抄自來源或正式 configure / ordering data。
- [[R&S CMX-RF42E]] 的更多資料在另一份 PD 3609.7719.22 specifications；本頁不得補推該文件版次、日期或額外規格。
- 報價與組態相容性需交由正式 configure 工具確認；wiki 只忠實記錄來源文字。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

### Short answer
The supported impact is that AI data center technology changes push measurement needs away from only wireless signaling/non-signaling RF checks and toward high-speed digital, SI/PI, PCB material/stackup, interconnect, jitter/phase-noise, optical, and power-integrity measurements; the passages do not directly state that a CMX500-type signaling tester alone covers AI data center interconnect validation, because CMX500 is described for LTE/NR/WLAN device signaling, TX measurements, application tests, and non-signaling verification use cases rather than AI data center electrical/optical interconnect tests [19][24][95].
### What changes in AI data centers drive new measurement needs
AI/data center connectivity is described as a full-spectrum portfolio covering high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection, so measurement coverage must span more than RF signaling behavior [3].  
High-speed electrical connectivity includes signals from ASIC packages to system endpoints, OSFP connectors optimized for signal integrity and thermal management, 448G connector solutions, OSFP cable assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T aggregate bandwidth, next-generation backplane connectors, and 224 Gb/s PAM4 mezzanine connectors [61].  
Optical connectivity adds 224 Gb/s-per-lane XPO-LPO, 1.6T OSFP transceivers, CPO from electrical interposer to optical conversion module and fiber plant, and other optical transceiver / AOC / fiber deployment elements [62].  
Power and cooling connectivity adds high-current busbar / cable / circuit-board power distribution, +54V M-CRPS connectors, high-power cable assemblies, OSFP cold plate and cage assemblies, liquid cooling leak detection, and liquid cooling quick disconnects [63].  
AI server PCB sources say the trend pushes PCBs toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission, with material upgrades such as HVLP copper foil, M8 CCL, low dielectric, low loss, and high thermal-dissipation design, plus process challenges such as 30–40 layer mainboards and 12–14× aspect ratio [80].  
### Measurement capability implications
For PCB / material / stackup validation, the required capabilities include impedance by TDR, Dk/Df extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, eye diagram, sampling tests, and process monitoring context [7][9].  
For high-speed PCB / PCBA signal integrity, the cited flow includes IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and TL calculator, while the broader validation challenge includes Tx/Rx packages, PCBs, connectors, equalization, ADC/DSP, and DAC paths [56].  
For instrument roles, the cited high-speed validation blocks map interface tests to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices; reference-clock and PLL jitter performance to phase-noise analyzers and signal generators; PDN to scopes and network analyzers; and ADC/DAC frontend performance to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [56][57].  
For AI server ecosystem solution mapping, R&S ZNA/ZNB are mapped to PCB IL/TDR, connector/cable high-speed cable tests, PCBA high-speed trace tests, and GPU TDR, while R&S FSWP is mapped to LDO noise spectral density, clock jitter, and switch jitter / phase-noise tests [66][67][69].  
For power-integrity and power electronics contexts in the mapping, MXO is listed for power rail, multiphase DC, and PI, ZISO is listed in server mainboard and power-supply categories, and BMS test is listed in the power-supply category, but the source does not provide formal setup, options, fixtures, or frequency details [67][70].  
For optical / SiPh / CPO context, the mapping links optical VNA to R&S ZNA/ZNB plus partner components, and notes that CPO raises active/passive SiPh, advanced packaging, and test demand, but this is not a formal R&S application note or proof of production adoption [6].  
### What this means for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester
A CMX500-type signaling tester is confirmed for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput, PER, application tests, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and remote-control interfaces [19].  
The callbox material positions CMX500 around RF testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, Go-NoGo testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing, and R&D Testing, and example use cases include desense testing, pre-conformance, SRS RF measurements, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [22][23][95].  
The cited AI data center measurement needs are instead high-speed channel, PCB, interconnect, jitter/phase-noise, PDN, optical VNA, and power-integrity measurements, so the required non-signaling capability for AI data center technology is better evidenced as high-speed digital / SI / PI / optical / power measurement capability rather than cellular/WLAN signaling callbox capability [56][57][67][69].  
【推論】If “Signaling / Non-signaling Tester” means a wireless callbox such as CMX500, AI data center changes do not mainly add more cellular signaling requirements in the cited passages; they mainly add non-signaling high-speed digital, PCB, optical, jitter, and power-integrity measurement requirements, because the AI data center passages describe high-speed interconnect/PCB/optical/power changes while the CMX500 passages describe LTE/NR/WLAN signaling and non-signaling RF/device verification [19][24][61][62][63][67].

- [[矽光子]]欄將 optical VNA 對應到 [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB]] + PSA with [[ThinkLands]]，以及 [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB]] + [[GOCA]] with [[Newkey]]。

- 這些說法都只追溯到 [[AISeverEcosystem]]，不等同於量產、採購、出貨或 R&S formal application note。

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

SerDes 與 SI PI 測試概覽 › 來源中的說法
- [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）封面標題為 **What is Serdes and SI/PI?**。
- [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（2026.3.4）把 R&S Group div 1 targets 寫成 **Digital**、**Power**、**RF**。
- [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（2026.3.4）在 Slide 11 以 **Transmission Channel and validation challenges electrical Interfaces** 描述高速電性介面的驗證挑戰。
- Slide 11 的資料路徑示意包含 Tx、Rx、Channel、Tx Package、PCBs、Connectors、Rx Package、EQ (FFE)、EQ (CTLE, DFE)、ADC + DSP、DSP + DAC 等圖上文字。
- Slide 11 將測試 / 驗證區塊連到儀器類型：Interface Test 對應 scopes、BERTs、AWGs、switch matrices；RefClk and PLL jitter performance 對應 phase noise analyzers 與 signal generators；[[Power Distribution Network]] 對應 scopes 與 network analyzers；ADC / DAC frontend performance 對應 spectrum analyzers 與 signal generators。
- Slide 20 題為 **Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA**，列出 [[IL]] / [[Xtalk]] / [[Eye diagram]]、[[TDR Impedance]]、[[Stackup Planner]]、[[TL Calculator]]。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › High-speed electrical connectivity
- [[Amphenol OverPass Cable Systems]] — 來源稱其 enable high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to end-points across the system。
- [[ExtremePort OSFP Connectors]] — 來源稱 connectors and cages have 60 contacts per port、0.6 mm pitch，並 optimized for signal integrity、thermal management and multi-lane pluggable architecture。
- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。
- [[Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector]] — 來源稱其是 next-generation high-speed backplane connector platform。
- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Optical 與 fiber connectivity
- [[Amphenol XPO-LPO]] — 來源稱其以 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels，面向 AI scale-up deployments。
- [[1.6T OSFP Transceivers]] — 來源稱 Amphenol 200G/lane optical modules support DR4、FR4、2×DR4、2×FR4、AOC、breakout AOC configurations with LC or MPO ports。
- [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] — 來源稱 Amphenol offers an architecture from high-density electrical interposer to linear optical conversion module to fiber plant。
- [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]] — 來源稱其為 12-channel duplex optical transceiver，up to 25Gbps per channel，300Gbps cumulative on multi-mode fiber。
- [[300G CXP2 Active Optical Cable]] — 來源稱 CXP2 to CXP2 AOC provides cost-effective plug and play cabling solution，delivers high hardware faceplate port density among existing SFF industry standards。
- [[CommScope Rapid Fiber Connect Platform]] — 來源稱其 simplifies and accelerates AI scaling by pre-integrating optics off-site and reducing on-site fiber connections。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Power 與 cooling connectivity
- [[Amphenol BarKlip I-O products]] / [[BarKlip Busbar Connectors]] — 來源稱其 distribute high-current power between busbars、cables and circuit boards，適用 power-dense data centers、OCP rack and power solutions。
- [[60 A Universal AC Input Connector and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet 2OU power distribution architecture standards，將 power 從 busway routing 到 power shelf。
- [[M-CRPS +54V Connectors and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet OCP M-CRPS power supply input specifications。
- [[PwrBlade ULTRA HD+ Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 Cable-to-Board serves as high-power I/O cable configuration in a low-profile design。
- [[OSFP-RHS 224G Cold Plate and Cage Assembly]] — 來源稱其 optimizes port thermal efficiency and reliability，meeting MSA requirements，並提供 one-step press assembly。
- [[Amphenol Liquid Cooling Leakage Detection Sensor Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 detects coolant leaks and ensures system reliability。
- [[Liquid Cooling Quick Disconnect Connectors]] — 來源稱其用於 high-efficiency thermal management。
